sous_titre: Millions de tonnes, par espèce, année 2025

Volailles de chair.texte: Broiler remained the largest segment at 400.38 million tonnes, up 3.7 percent

Porcs.texte: Pig followed at 380.91 million tonnes, up 3.0 percent, with recovery in Asian herds

Poules pondeuses.texte: Layer reached 180.13 million tonnes, up 3.2 percent, supported by stable egg demand

Vaches laitières.texte: Dairy rose 2.6 percent to 170.29 million tonnes

Bovins de boucherie.texte: Beef increased modestly by 0.5 percent to 134.18 million tonnes, constrained by tight cattle cycles

Aquaculture.texte: Aquaculture recorded the strongest growth at 4.7 percent, reaching 55.47 million tonnes
